alex: FYI OOM on shard-prod-3 at 05:10 UTC, looks like recurring kv-residency drift after heavy bulk-import. quick heap tail attached: https://logs.company/oom/1718305555

mei: paste?

alex: heap.used_mb 9800 -> 19840 over 4h; kv.live: 600k -> 2.4M; gc.pause.p90 14ms -> 45ms

tom: sounds like sticky-residency + fragmentation. i'll own a quick canary: soft-evict 65% on 2 nodes tomorrow 08:00 PST and collect residency/latency deltas.

claire: i'll run alloc sampling and survivor histograms across the service for 48h, aim to surface delayed-free sites. report by Wed.

alex: let's list actions to add to tracker (short):

mei: Action: canary soft-evict -> owner: tom -> due: 2026-03-24 08:00 PST -> success: <4% errors, >=10% residency drop

claire: Action: alloc sampling + survivor histograms -> owner: claire -> due: 2026-03-25 EOD -> success: top 3 alloc sites identified

alex: Action: add residency-growth alert + autoscale rule -> owner: alex -> due: 2026-03-24 noon PST -> success: rule tested in staging

ops-bot: Created issue INF-4840 - "Bulk-import KV residency drift / OOM followups" (https://jira.company/browse/INF-4840). Assigned: tom, claire, alex, mei.

mei: I'll add canary checklist and calendar invite.

tom: starting canary prep now, will post dashboard link to INF-4840.

claire: starting sampling run in staging.

alex: thanks all. please paste PRs/dashboards into INF-4840 and post short nightly summaries to #eng-oncall for the week.

ops-bot: Incident note appended to INF-4840: "Recurring KV residency drift observed post bulk-import; follow-ups assigned; canary + profiling in progress."
